exposure: Cervical Bishop score (categorized as <=3 and 3<score<7) prior to labor induction
outcome: Cervical Bishop scores after catheter placement
Failure rate of induction of labor
cohort: 688 primiparas at term who received cervical ripening with a Foley catheter balloon.
finding: The success rates of induction of labor by Foley catheter balloon differed based on initial cervical Bishop score, with higher failure rates and incidence of intrauterine infection observed in primiparas with severe cervical immaturity (Bishop score <= 3).
